instruction: Candid action photograph, medium full shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym, the dark-skinned boxer in red shorts (R2) on the left ducks his head and throws a punch. On the right, the light-skinned boxer in black shorts (R1) stands his ground, blocking the punch with his black gloves. The action is captured through the black ring ropes under bright overhead lighting.
